thesis: A net-cash Chinese pharmacy chain with rising ROIC trades low in its own P/E range and below its 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA while in a healthy uptrend, though peers are cheaper on cash multiples and regulation caps margins.
reason: Scorecard gives 4: high and rising ROIC, net cash, a deep own-history discount with a healthy uptrend; regulation and cheaper peers keep it at the standard size, which Python sets. Cash is at the floor and China/HK is near its cap, so it replaces a China holding.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 15%, giving up most of the rise from 14.0% in FY2021 to 24.9%.
TTM operating margin falls below 8.5%, under the five-year low of 8.9%.
TTM gross margin falls below 36%, showing drug-pricing or reimbursement pressure.
TTM FCF margin falls below 8%, under the FY2021 level of 8.6%.

replacement_reason: Same CNY consumer exposure and net cash, but Yifeng earns roughly double the ROIC with rising returns and a similar own-history discount; selling the brewer frees the China/HK room and cash this buy needs.
